channel.title: Smart Cities Dive - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Smart Cities Dive (smartcitiesdive.com)

item.title: How Trump could make good on his threats to cut ‘sanctuary’ city funding
item.description: The administration could quietly squeeze cities through discretionary grants, a legal expert says. Here’s how cities should prepare for Trump’s Feb. 1 deadline.

item.title: Minneapolis, Philadelphia and Miami metros debate incinerator plans
item.description: Advocates continue to pressure officials to close or cut off waste shipments to incinerators in Minneapolis and the Philadelphia area. But progress continues on an incinerator in Miami-Dade County, Florida.

item.title: Local officials nationwide move to hold federal immigration agents accountable after Alex Pretti’s death
item.description: Mayors, attorneys general and lawmakers are advancing new laws and coalitions to prosecute federal agents who exceed their lawful authority. “It can happen anywhere,” a Minnesota mayor said.

item.title: Surface transportation bill will shape the U.S. transportation outlook
item.description: Preserving public transit funding, increasing safety and issues of local and state control are among stakeholder priorities. Can lawmakers forge a bipartisan path forward?

item.title: How cities are using AI in 2026
item.description: “We’re all in learning mode … and looking at it with a wary eye,” one mayor said about AI’s potential for municipal operations. Read more in this 2026 outlook.

item.title: Where one investor sees distressed apartment opportunities
item.description: Neighborhood Ventures is launching a second opportunistic $25 million fund to acquire troubled multifamily properties.

item.title: Ohio DOT-Honda project demonstrates connected vehicle road hazard detection
item.description: Connected vehicle data could improve worker safety and reduce costs, partners said about the two-year project's results.

item.title: The Smart Cities outlook for 2026: Pressure points for city leaders
item.description: As cities navigate housing reform, transportation needs, climate resilience, AI and changes in federal funding, 2026 will be a consequential year for how they govern, budget and protect their autonomy.

item.title: Utah is planning to construct a vast homeless shelter. Some critics are calling it a ‘detention camp.’
item.description: Two members of Congress joined the National Homelessness Law Center in calling for a rejection of federal funding for the 1,300-bed facility in Salt Lake City.

item.title: Can the maker economy drive local economic revitalization? Six Michigan communities are about to find out.
item.description: The Recast Leaders program is training participants from six Southeastern Michigan communities in how supporting small-scale manufacturing can boost ailing downtowns and business districts.
